title: Introduce prompt-version-graph and regression-shim CI integration
author: Lena Ortiz
description: Motivation: prompt edits are an increasingly common source of regressions; current CI gates treat each prompt set blob as a flat file so we lack lineage and cannot automatically detect changes that should trigger anchor re-evaluations. This PR adds a lightweight prompt-version-graph and a regression-shim CI integration that reasons over prompt ancestry, canonicalization diffs, and historical anchor stability to decide whether to run a full regression eval or only incremental checks. Design: 1) prompt-version-graph: a small merkle-ish DAG stored as JSONL in eval artifacts that records prompt id, author, canonicalized fingerprint, parent_ids, and gated-metadata (weights, cohort tags). 2) canonicalization pipeline: deterministic whitespace/quote normalization, paraphrase-safe token mapping, and optional semantic-normalizer hook (configurable per-repo) that reduces accidental diffs from formatting or templating changes. 3) regression-shim CI hook: a fast pre-check that uses the graph to locate nearest stable anchor snapshot and compute an estimated impact score (delta-score) from prompt change via token-overlap and semantic-similarity heuristics; if delta-score > configured threshold or prompt is root-of-new-branch then a full smoke/regression job is enqueued; otherwise a quick local-lint + sampled-smoke run is triggered. 4) CLI and GitHub Action: `tools/prompt-graph scan|update` and `ci/actions/prompt-graph-check.yml` to wire the pre-check into existing eval CI. Changes: - new modules: eval_harness/prompt_graph.py (graph model + serialization + small LRU cache), eval_harness/canonicalizers.py (deterministic normalizers + tests), ci/hooks/regression_shim.py (entrypoint used by GH action), tools/prompt_graph.py (CLI), tests/ (unit + integration smoke harness). Backwards compatibility: the graph is optional; when absent the CI falls back to existing path. Migration: on merge a one-time backfill job is triggered (scripts/graph_backfill.py) that runs against known prompt sets to create initial graph nodes. Checklist: - [x] core graph model + unit tests - [x] canonicalizer suite + test vectors - [x] lightweight delta estimator algorithm and calibrated thresholds - [x] GH Action + integration tests - [x] docs: docs/eval/prompt-versioning.md - [x] migration script and runbook (runbook included in PR) Commits: abbreviated list here (full history in git): * 9b2d4f3 add prompt_graph core model and serializer * 6f5c1a8 add canonicalizers and unit tests for whitespace/quote-normalization * d3b7a6e implement regression_shim and local estimator * e1a9b21 add GH action and CI wiring + integration test * f2c4b90 add backfill script, runbook and docs Changed files (high level): - eval_harness/prompt_graph.py - eval_harness/canonicalizers.py - ci/hooks/regression_shim.py - tools/prompt_graph.py - ci/actions/prompt-graph-check.yml - scripts/graph_backfill.py - docs/eval/prompt-versioning.md - tests/test_prompt_graph.py - tests/test_canonicalizers.py - tests/integration/test_regression_shim.py Review summary: - Marcus: requested clearer invariants around canonicalization and asked for a faster path when only whitespace or variable-name-only changes are detected. Response: added deterministic variable-placeholder detection and short-circuit in estimator. - Yuki: asked for security review on storing prompt author metadata; we limited author to username and added masking for any PII; added KMS-annotated artifact tag. - Diego: asked for metrics (how often shim avoids full job); added metrics: eval.prompt_graph.delta_score, eval.prompt_graph.skipped_regressions, eval.prompt_graph.full_evals_triggered and wired these into the console dashboard. CI details: initial CI run failed due to flaky integration with tokenizer on Python 3.10; fixed by pinning tokenizers to 0.14.2 and adding a deterministic seed in tests. Final CI: all checks passed (unit, integration, lint, mypy). Performance: delta-estimator runs in ~12ms median per prompt on CI runners; full graph backfill measured ~1.2s per prompt set during dry-run. Rollout plan: feature flagged as `prompt_graph.enabled` default false; enable for small repos first (eval-harness core prompt-sets) and monitor the `skipped_regressions` rate and downstream alerting. Release notes: "Add prompt-version-graph and regression-shim CI hook to reduce unnecessary full regressions by detecting semantically irrelevant prompt edits; includes CLI, GH Action, migration backfill, and runbook." Merge: squash-merged into main on 2025-11-07.
